fields.title: About Tayara Travel Insurance
fields.content: Tayara Travel Insurance is an innovative travel insurance platform delivering instant digital insurance policies globally since 2020. Our electronic certificates are backed by international underwriters and accepted by embassies worldwide.

fields.title: Terms & Conditions
fields.content: Comprehensive terms and conditions of travel insurance contract, liability exclusions, claim reporting deadlines, and policyholder rights.

fields.title: Privacy Policy
fields.content: Information on GDPR compliance, encryption standards, data protection, and secure payment handling.

fields.title: Refund Policy
fields.content: Full refund is granted if cancellation is requested prior to the start of the insurance coverage period.

fields.question: How can I or border control verify my policy authenticity?
fields.answer: You can verify any policy at any time using our public verification tool at /api/v1/policies/validate/{policy_number} or by scanning the QR code on your policy certificate.

fields.question: How quickly will I receive my insurance policy?
fields.answer: Immediately after successful payment! The electronic insurance certificate and policy document are generated automatically and sent to your email within seconds.

fields.question: Is Tayara insurance valid for Schengen visa applications?
fields.answer: Yes! All Tayara policies fully meet Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament. They include €30,000+ medical cover, repatriation, and zero deductible across all 29 Schengen states.

fields.question: Does the policy cover COVID-19?
fields.answer: Yes, all our plans (Start, Gold, Max+) cover diagnostic testing, outpatient care, and inpatient hospitalization associated with acute COVID-19 infection.

fields.question: Can I cancel my policy and get a refund?
fields.answer: Yes. You can request a refund prior to the policy start date directly via our online refund request form.
